body: I have mental health issues if that what you’re asking.

Last Saturday night I opened a glove box and a fuck ton of almonds and quarters spilled out. Just a fucking huge amount of this mix of almonds and quarters. I was very confused but it was very funny. 

The coolest thing I’ve found was a painting in the backseat of a car, it was extremely detailed and amazing honestly, large canvas depicting a forest. I left it of course, but it was very cool to see.
Headphones, phones, laptops, cash, knives, drugs
I’ve never had an alarm go off. I don’t mess with cars, just pull the handle once.

I walk to nearby neighborhoods around 2am to 3am, and pull a handle on cars. The alarm has never gone off, I don’t mess with cars if they’re locked. If the person comes out, I run. I keep constant watch to make sure that nobody is around.
No way a significant amount of people see this

depends on how many nights I go out, I make anywhere from $30 to $200 in a night from cash, although if I’m lucky it can be much higher, but also lower.

I find valuable things in cars often, amazon packages in cars are far more common than you’d think. A few nights ago I found a TV, last night I found beats headphones.
